introHtml: High visibility products ensure your team stays seen on job sites, during night events, or in low-light conditions. From safety vests to reflective armbands, these items combine OSHA-compliant visibility with your logo. Safety managers and marketing directors alike choose high visibility gear for trade shows, construction crews, or charity runs. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for durable brand exposure that works as hard as your crew.
